$comment: Image templates: every layout on the Figma page "8. Brand assets" (file Qx2i6GhXZD1V4O7RE7hYQi) as a scene in canvas pixels, with the frame sizes and positions from its layer tree. Text tops are the top of the capitals; sizes and line pitches are measured from the reference renders (Funnel Display 44 to 112, DM Sans 14 to 27). Lights: b is the Light B layer (x, y, width, height in the window), shift the step to Light G and Light R, window the frame it shows through. Photos are slots filled from --image in order; without one a slot is the card fill. Slots default to the brand copy; {domain} and {tagline} come from brand.json. Third-party pictures and real names from the Figma are never shipped.
